caseName: Halliburton Oil Well Cementing Co. v. Walker
caseNameFull: Halliburton Oil Well Cementing Co. v. Walker, doing business as Depthograph Company
attorneys: Earl Babcock and H. C. Robb, Sr. for petitioner.

opinions.text: The petition for rehearing in this case is granted and the case is restored to the docket for reargument before a full bench. The motion to withhold issuance of the mandate is also granted.
